metadata.title: Brief von Lotte Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [Januar 1942], SZ-AAL/B1.194

context:
## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Lotte Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [Januar 1942], SZ-AAL/B1.194
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.194
- Datum: 01.1942
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
Dear Hannah & Manfred, There is nothing to relate as we have no news
from you; mail has been rather irregular during the last weeks after
the declaration of war in U.S. and{to} the Christmas postage. My book
has appeared since in Sweden, both swedish and in the original language,
but I have no copies - I hope you have recieved from Newyork the edition
of Romains on my humble person in English; there is also a French edi-
tion, but we get no copies; we are nearly cut off with books from the
whole world and the idea, that this shall continue for two or three
years is nearly as hard for me than for you to be so far from Eva.
Please transmit this letter to Newman Flower. Here is no change in
our life, all quiet, but the perspective to live for years in such a Brasi-
hen solitude not just that what I expected formerly for my old age

love to you all! Stefan
Kindest regards from little dog!
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief von Stefan Zweig. Die Anmerkung 'love to you all! Stefan' steht am linken Rand, 'Kindest regards from little dog!' am rechten Rand.
